# Pakistan NIH IDSR capture

`nih_weekly_index.html` and `nih_2026_w42.pdf` are unmodified official response
bytes captured on 2026-11-17. URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in `provenance.json`.
The PDF has 25 pages; the supported Table 1 is on page 5. It reports 28 suspected
case categories across seven provinces/areas and a published total. Punjab is
`NR`, so the total is not complete national incidence. Explicit zero remains zero;
`NR` remains unknown. This table contains no deaths. Laboratory results on page
16 are outside this adapter's current numerical contract.

The source identifies 2026 week 42 without verified calendar boundaries. January
1 in normalized holding rows is a storage anchor only. Source year/week remain
explicit dimensions; this fixture does not establish ISO week dates or public
reuse permission.
